You know version control is more than just a subsystem. It’s the backbone of how teams build software. You’re ready to shape the future of code-change workflows, from local commits to AI-assisted reviews. If you’re excited by the challenge of turning a core IDE feature into a standalone ecosystem, this is for you.
About JetBrains
We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

Version control is a critical part of our IDEs, but we want to take it further. We’re turning VCS into a strategic product direction and, eventually, we aim to grow it into a dedicated ecosystem. This role exists to define what that future looks like right now.
As the Senior Product Manager, you’ll figure out where JetBrains should play in the VCS space, how to evolve our Git and code review experiences, and what new opportunities exist beyond our current tools.

You’ll have the ownership to set a clear product vision that covers everything from complex local merges to remote, containerized, and AI-assisted workflows. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering and quality leads, as well as product marketing, developer advocacy, and the IntelliJ Platform teams.

Together, you'll figure out how to handle the next era of software delivery, including tracking provenance and reviewing AI-generated changes across different environments.

Set the long-term product strategy for VCS and code-change workflows across all JetBrains IDEs.
Identify gaps in current developer workflows and define new product directions in the VCS space.
Explore new opportunities, from cross-IDE VCS clients and host-neutral code reviews to AI-native review and authorship tracking.
Listen closely to what the community and the industry are saying to figure out exactly what we should be working on.
Align roadmap decisions across the product, engineering, design, marketing, developer advocacy, partnership, and customer-facing teams.
Work with engineering and quality leads to balance user value, technical constraints, and platform health.
Shape external positioning and represent our VCS direction in conversations with customers and the broader developer tools community.

A collaborative mindset that works well with engineering and quality teams on deeply technical challenges.
Strong product judgment, especially when navigating ambiguous areas to define a new ecosystem.
The ability to think beyond existing boundaries and spot opportunities for entirely new workflows.
Clear communication skills, whether you’re aligning internal stakeholders or talking to deeply technical users.
A data-informed approach, combining usage metrics, customer feedback, and market signals to make decisions.
An interest in how AI is changing software development, from generated commits to AI-assisted reviews.
A drive to improve solutions instead of copying what already exists.
What you’ll need
Previous success leading the product direction and strategy for technically complex developer tools, SCM, CI/CD, or code collaboration software.
The proven ability to translate intricate developer workflows into clear product roadmaps.
Experience bringing stakeholders together across product, engineering, marketing, and developer advocacy.
A deep understanding of version control mechanics, code-change workflows, and how developers actually ship code.
Based in the EU, ideally Munich, Prague, Amsterdam, Berlin, Belgrade, or remote within the EU, with the ability to travel to JetBrains offices as needed.
As a plus, familiarity with advanced version control scenarios, such as complex merges, monorepos, and enterprise/self-hosted setups.
What success looks like
Success means moving VCS from a platform subsystem to a clear, strategic ecosystem. You’ll have built a compelling product vision that engineering teams are aligned on and customers are excited about. You won’t just be copying what exists.

You’ll be finding entirely new ways to solve code-change workflows, especially as AI becomes a bigger part of development. Ultimately, you’ll earn your team's trust by making sound decisions, keeping projects moving, and leaving the product better than you found it.

s.h: WITH PASSION AND EXPERIENCE, YOU CAN ACHIEVE ANYTHING
s.t:
What do a top-of-the-line mountain bike, an artificial hip joint, and a smartphone have in common? We develop the software used to manufacture these high-end products! With hyperMILL®, we control CNC machines and set the highest standards for performance and part quality.
We are one of the world’s leading developers of high-performance CAD/CAM solutions—and have been for more than 30 years! Our innovative CAD/CAM technologies deliver significantly higher performance in the programming process and set international standards in machining.
For our product management team, we are seeking an experienced Product Manager (m/f/d) to start as soon as possible, with a strong understanding of machining processes and 2.5D, 3-axis, and 5-axis machining.
Your main tasks

s.h: Customer Needs Analysis and Market Validation
s.t: Identification, prioritization, and validation of customer requirements, market potential, and technological opportunities in the field of 2.5D, 3-axis, and 5-axis machining
Supporting product development from problem definition and discovery through design to the successful market launch of new features and solutions
Evaluating requirements in terms of customer benefit, technical feasibility, and strategic relevance, as well as actively shaping product strategy
Validating new concepts and solutions through customer feedback, field testing, and structured risk analyses
Collaborating with development, QA, application engineering, support, marketing, and sales to ensure consistent and successful product development

s.h: Product Integration and Accountability for Goals
s.t:
Ensuring the consistent integration of new features in terms of user experience, product strategy, and the overall hyperMILL concept, as well as taking responsibility for achieving defined product goals and the sustainable improvement of customer value
Your profile
In-depth knowledge of machining and a thorough understanding of CAM processes, CNC machines, control systems, tools, and manufacturing processes
Several years of professional experience in CAM, machining, or product management, as well as experience in the development, validation, and market launch of technical product solutions

s.h: Analytical and structured approach to work
s.t: Confident assessment of requirements, risks, and priorities, as well as the ability to present complex technical issues in a clear and understandable manner
Confident interaction with customers, interdisciplinary teams, and stakeholders

You will own the roadmap for a core part of Diligent’s governance, risk and compliance SaaS platform, shaping how senior leaders and boards collaborate, communicate and make decisions in a secure, modern way. You’ll turn customer problems and market insights into simple, impactful product experiences, and work closely with engineering, design, and go ‑ to ‑ market teams to bring them to life.

In this Senior Product Manager role, you’ll spend your time deeply understanding customer needs, prioritising what truly moves the needle, and defining clear success metrics for everything you ship. You’ll lead a cross ‑ functional squad, manage the product backlog, and launch features that drive engagement, adoption and measurable outcomes for our customers across the Diligent Platform.

Here’s a breakdown of what you’ll do (not all of it, just the important stuff)

· Own and continuously refine the product roadmap for your area, using customer insight, data and market trends to prioritise what to build next.

· Define and drive product strategy that aligns with Diligent’s vision for modern governance, connecting your roadmap to clear business and customer outcomes.

· Act as the voice of the customer: run discovery, validate problems and solutions, and translate insights into clear user stories and product requirements.

· Lead an agile, cross ‑ functional team (engineering, UX, product marketing, sales, customer success) to design, build and launch high ‑ quality SaaS features.

· Set goals, KPIs and success metrics for your product, track performance and user engagement, and iterate based on what the data and customers tell you.

· Tackle complex product and execution challenges by breaking down ambiguous problems, navigating trade ‑ offs, and making clear, data ‑ informed decisions.

These are the essentials you’ll need to get an interview

· Solid experience as a Product Manager building, shipping, and iterating B2B Enterprise SaaS products and AI assistants and Agents, with a proven track record of defining and launching successful features or products.

· Strong hands ‑ on experience working in agile, cross ‑ functional product teams, including backlog management and writing user stories.

· Comfortable leading customer discovery and validation conversations and turning qualitative and quantitative insights into product decisions.

· Proven ability to influence and align cross ‑ functional partners and senior stakeholders without formal authority.

· Data ‑ driven mindset: confident with metrics, experimentation and basic quantitative reasoning to set goals, measure impact and debug product issues.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas simply to both technical and non ‑ technical audiences.

· A bias for action and ownership: you’re happy to roll up your sleeves, make trade ‑ offs and drive a project from problem definition through to launch and iteration.

It would be great if you had these too, but we’ll support you if you don’t

· Experience in governance, risk, compliance, security, fintech or other B2B enterprise domains.

· Exposure to large ‑ scale, multi ‑ product platforms or secure communication/collaboration tools.

· Experience mentoring other product managers or playing a “bar ‑ raiser” role in product quality and decision ‑ making.

Die campoint AG ist Technologiepartner und Betreiber einer der größten deutschsprachigen Plattformen für die Creator Economy und Digital Entertainment - von der Consumer-Plattform bis zur B2B-Infrastruktur, mit der Creators und Agenturen ihr Business aufbauen und steuern.

Dabei sind Creators für uns keine User, sondern Unternehmer, deren Erfolg unmittelbar von unseren Produkten abhängt. Das bestimmt, wie wir priorisieren. Wir gestalten nach unserer Vision. Wir leben von Teamplay, Hands-on-Mentalität und einer Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe.
Aufgaben
Du bekommst echte Ownership für zugewiesene Produkt-Streams innerhalb unseres B2B-Portfolios. Das bedeutet: Du entscheidest, was gebaut wird und was nicht - auf Basis von Creator-Feedback, Umsatzdaten und strategischem Rahmen. Wir haben keine langen Abstimmungsrunden. Du bist das Quality-Gateway für Dein Team und Eure Releases.
Du navigierst eigenständig durch ein komplexes Stakeholder-Umfeld. Wir erwarten, dass Du Konflikte direkt löst - nicht eskalierst.
Die strategische Richtung gibt der Head of Product vor. Deine Aufgabe ist es, sie mit hoher Eigenständigkeit und Qualitätsanspruch umzusetzen und innerhalb Deiner Streams bessere Entscheidungen zu treffen, als wenn er sie selbst treffen würde.
Das ist kein Stepping-Stone in die Produktstrategie. Das ist eine Rolle für jemanden, der im Operativen exzellent ist und das als Stärke sieht, nicht als Einschränkung.
Du verantwortest Discovery, Priorisierung und Delivery in Deinen Produkt-Streams von Anfang bis Ende.
Du übersetzt qualitative Creator-Insights und starke Signale direkt in mutige Entscheidungen - ohne Dich in endlosen Datenanalysen ("Analysis Paralysis") zu verlieren.
Du schreibst klare Specs und Tickets, die ohne Nacharbeit ins Development gehen.
Du erkennst, wann ein Prozess oder Sprint-Ritual der schnellen Problemlösung im Weg steht, und brichst es pragmatisch in Absprache mit dem Team auf.
Du holst externe Impulse aktiv rein und arbeitest sie pragmatisch ein.
Du behältst den Überblick über technische Abhängigkeiten, ohne Dich in ihnen zu verlieren.
Qualifikation

Du hast 4–6 Jahre Erfahrung als PO oder PM in einem digitalen Produkt-Umfeld mit nachweisbarer Execution-Qualität, nicht nur Prozess-Compliance.
Du baust Dir schnell echtes Verständnis von Plattform-Logik, Creator-Mindset und wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhängen auf.
Du besitzt ein hohes UX-Gespür und ästhetisches Urteil: Du erkennst intuitiv gute Usability und kannst Design-Entscheidungen aus Creator-Sicht begründen, statt sie nur analytisch zu zerlegen.
Du verfügst über eine wirtschaftliche und psychologische Intuition rund um Monetarisierung, Nutzerverhalten und Einkommenspsychologie.
Deine Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch fließend, Englisch working proficiency.

Du nutzt AI-Tools (Claude Cowork, ChatGPT o.ä.) selbstverständlich für Discovery, Spec-Writing und Priorisierung - nicht als Spielerei, sondern um schneller zu besseren Entscheidungen zu kommen.
Du bewertest AI-Output kritisch, statt ihn unreflektiert zu übernehmen - Du erkennst Halluzinationen und schwache Annahmen.
Du verstehst, wo AI in unseren Produkten selbst Creator-Mehrwert schaffen kann und denkst das aktiv in Deiner Priorisierung mit.

Du besitzt Erfahrung mit Creator-/Freelancer-Plattformen, Subscription-Flows oder Content-Monetarisierung.
Du hast bereits in einem regulatorisch komplexen Umfeld gearbeitet.
Du verfügst über Erfahrung mit Prompt-Engineering oder dem Aufbau AI-gestützter Workflows/Agenten in Deinem bisherigen PM-Alltag.

Flexibilität, die passt: Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und der Option auf Remote-Arbeit gestaltest Du Deinen Arbeitstag so, wie er für Dich am besten funktioniert.
Inspiration und Freiraum: Unser moderner Campus bietet nicht nur ein kreatives Arbeitsumfeld, sondern auch einen eigenen Outdoor-Bereich mit Grill- und Volleyballplatz – der perfekte Ort, um Energie zu tanken und neue Ideen zu entwickeln.
Gemeinsam stark: Wir leben eine Kultur, die auf Wertschätzung, Vertrauen und Offenheit basiert. Flache Hierarchien und agile Strukturen sorgen dafür, dass jede Meinung zählt und wir auf Augenhöhe zusammenarbeiten.
Bereit für Deinen Start: Ab Tag eins bist Du bestens ausgestattet. Topaktuelle Hardware, persönliche Welcome Bag und ein Onboarding, das Dich wirklich abholt.
Dein Wachstum, unser Antrieb: Wir investieren in Deine Weiterbildung! Ob durch unser vielfältiges Trainingsangebot oder individuelle Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten – wir unterstützen Dich auf Deinem Weg.
Aktiv und fit: Mit JobRad zur Arbeit, Trainingseinheiten im eigenen Fitnessstudio, Beachvolleyball-Matches oder Laufgruppen – unser sportliches Angebot kennt keine Grenzen. Für Abenteuerlustige steht auch mal ein Ausflug nach Sölden auf dem Plan!
Unvergessliche Momente: Ob Sommerfeste, Weihnachtsfeiern oder spontane Team-Events - wir feiern gemeinsam die Erfolge und den Spaß an der Arbeit.
Das gewisse Extra: Bester Kaffee aus Siebträgermaschinen, frisches Bio-Obst und freie Getränke.
Klingt nach Dir?
Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Uns interessiert vor allem, was Dich antreibt, warum die Rolle zu Dir passt und wann Du bei uns starten könntest.

Bei epilot gestaltest du direkt mit, wie über 200 Energieunternehmen ihre Produkte digitalisieren – von der Netzanschluss-Anfrage, über die Photovoltaikanlage bis hin zum Stromtarif. Wir suchen einen Product Manager mit echtem Product Mindset und dem Hunger, etwas aufzubauen – ob du dich "Senior" nennst oder nicht, ist uns dabei egal.

Was zählt: wie du denkst, wie du entscheidest und wie ambitioniert du an deine Arbeit herangehst. Du verantwortest einen zentralen Produktbereich, arbeitest eng mit Engineering und Design zusammen und bringst datengetriebene Entscheidungen auf die Roadmap.

Kein Konzernumfeld, kein endloser Abstimmungsmarathon – sondern echter Gestaltungsraum in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden SaaS-Scale-Ups der Energiewirtschaft.
epilot digitalisiert die Energiewirtschaft mit einer einzigartigen Cloud-Software. Wir sind ein wachsendes Scale-Up im Herzen von Köln. Unsere Mission: epilot revolutioniert die Zusammenarbeit aller Marktpartner, die in der Energiewelt zur Erbringung von Produkten und Dienstleistungen zusammenarbeiten. Wir bieten innerhalb der Cloudwelt ein großes Netzwerk aus Partnern, welches durch die Community ständig erweitert wird.
Das erwartet dich
Verantwortung deines Produktbereichs von der Strategie bis zur Auslieferung – mit voller Ownership über Discovery, Roadmap und Ergebnis.
Du arbeitest täglich eng mit einem cross-funktionalen Team aus Engineers und Designern zusammen und schaffst klare Prioritäten.
Übersetzung von Kunden-Feedback, Marktanalysen und Business-Ziele in konkrete Features – und du weißt, wann du etwas weglassen musst.
Du nutzt deine starken analytischen Fähigkeiten und dein tiefes Verständnis für unsere Kund:innen, um unser Produkt im Markt strategisch auszurichten und zu differenzieren.
Du triffst smarte Entscheidungen basierend auf der Auswertung von KPI’s, sowie Kunden- und Marktanalysen.
Hands-on im Code: Kleine PRs, Konfigurationsänderungen oder das direkte Testen im Code sind für dich kein Tabu – du verstehst, was unter der Haube passiert, und das macht dich zu einem besseren PM.
Das bringst du mit
Du denkst wie ein Entrepreneur – du verstehst unsere Business-Ziele und wie deine täglichen Entscheidungen diese beeinflussen.
Nachweisbare Erfolge: Features oder Produkte, die du von der Idee bis zum Launch verantwortet hast und auf deren Wirkung du stolz bist.
Kommunikationsstärke gegenüber verschiedenen Stakeholdern: u.a. Engineers, Sales, Geschäftsführung & Kund:innen.
Auf sich ändernde Bedingungen und Anforderungen reagierst du schnell, hast eine starke Do-it Mentalität und bist ein Mensch, der Unkonventionelles mag.

About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia.

As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges. We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal.

The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved. What you'll be doing
Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.
Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.
Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.
Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.
Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.
Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.
Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.
What you'll need
Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.
Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.
Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).
AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.
Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.
Outcomes
Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap
Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch
Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds
AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted
Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged
Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location
This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Philippines . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Philippines . Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1.

Online assessment or practical task 2. Role-specific interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized. Originally posted on Himalayas

Grafana Labs is a remote-first, open-source powerhouse. There are more than 20M users of Grafana, the open source visualization tool, around the globe, monitoring everything from beehives to climate change in the Alps.

The instantly recognizable dashboards have been spotted everywhere from a NASA launch and Minecraft HQ to Wimbledon and the Tour de France.

Grafana Labs also helps more than 3,000 companies -- including Bloomberg, JPMorgan Chase, and eBay -- manage their observability strategies with the Grafana LGTM Stack, which can be run fully managed with Grafana Cloud or self-managed with the Grafana Enterprise Stack, both featuring scalable metrics (Grafana Mimir), logs (Grafana Loki), and traces (Grafana Tempo).
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Canada EST. About Product Management: As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs , you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain.

You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders.

The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential. Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM.

You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

As the Senior Product Manager for Infrastructure Observability (Infra O11y) you’ll be responsible for our most popular Grafana Cloud products that span the infrastructure suite: Kubernetes Monitoring and Cloud Provider Observability. Infra O11y provides our customers with the ability to easily monitor their core services – from our smallest self-serve customers to our largest enterprise customers.
Your primary responsibility will be to help define the vision and ensure the long-term success of Infra O11y, working with your engineering partners to fine-tune product strategy. You will be charting the path forward for net-new product initiatives – like Host Monitoring – balanced with maintaining a strong roadmap and customer satisfaction for our most mature products.
Your role will require heavy customer discovery, understanding user needs, and building consensus and alignment across several Engineering groups and many stakeholders as we look towards simplifying our broader Infra O11y experience for Grafana Cloud. You will also need to flex your GTM muscles and build conviction in areas like competitive analysis and sales enablement to better inform activities like pricing and packaging.
Beyond driving your individual product area, you’ll also need to ensure that the experiences you’re building are tightly woven into our overall Grafana Cloud suite of products, by establishing integration touchpoints with other key offerings like Grafana Cloud Knowledge Graph and Grafana Assistant, so that our customers have a seamless monitoring experience where they can easily navigate between different layers of their architecture through guided explorations and natural language.

Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points
Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities
Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers.
Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering

s.h: What makes you a great fit
s.t:
A BS/BA in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience
7+ years of experience in Product Management
5+ years of experience in a B2B SaaS product
Experience using or building developer-facing tools, APIs, or platform services
Ability to discuss APIs, data models, schema evolution, and distributed systems concepts
Experience driving adoption of shared services or platform capabilities across multiple product teams
Experience working with Engineering and Design teams build delightful products and features – with sounds UX – in a fast-paced environment
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders

Experience with open source software and/or commercial open source companies
Experience using or building observability products and/or developer tools, either internally as an SRE or for external customers
Proficient with infrastructure concepts and components – like Kubernetes, Cloud Service Providers, and VMs – and able to articulate these models in human-readable terms
Experience with AI tools

Location Our Technical Product Owner - DoiT Cloud Intelligence - Core Services will be an integral part of our global Product team. This role is based remotely in the East Coast US, the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel.

Who We Are DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multi-cloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multi-cloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more.

An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity We’re hiring a Technical Product Owner to drive rapid delivery and iteration for the Core Services team of DoiT Cloud Intelligence, our platform that helps DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, and FinOps teams manage public cloud environments effectively and efficiently.

Core Services builds and operates foundational platform capabilities used across DoiT’s products and engineering teams. Its responsibilities include identity and access management, authentication and authorization, customer and tenant services, shared APIs, platform integrations, and other cross-cutting capabilities.

This role is designed for someone with a technical product mindset who is comfortable working deep within platform architecture, distributed systems, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and internal engineering workflows.

You will help turn broad platform needs into clear technical product direction, sequenced investments, and reliably delivered capabilities. You will report to a VP of Product and work as an embedded member of the Core Services Engineering team.

You will collaborate closely with engineering leadership, architects, security, product teams, and internal platform consumers to determine what the team should build next and why. Role clarity: VP of Product vs. Technical Product Owner VP of Product (what they own)
Sets the overall vision, strategy, positioning, and long-range roadmap for the platform area.
Makes the highest-level prioritization calls across multiple components and investment themes.
Aligns stakeholders across the company (executive leadership, GTM, partners) on direction and tradeoffs.
Defines success at the portfolio/area level and ensures the area’s outcomes ladder up to company goals.
Technical Product Owner (what you own)
Owns delivery, iteration, and learning velocity for the Core Services.
Turns VP-level direction into clear problems to solve, a prioritized backlog, and incrementally shippable scope.
Runs the feedback loop: discover → define → build → release → measure → iterate, repeatedly.
Works within the Engineering teams to ensure they are always building the highest-value next increment with clarity, quality
Review technical designs, reason about tradeoffs and constraints, and understand their impact on delivery timelines and system behavior, without being the primary implementer
Leverages deep, hands-on DevOps experience and public cloud understanding to ensure that solution implementations are done correctly
This distinction matters: the VP creates the “why” and “where”; the Product Owner ensures the “what next” is always sharp, validated, and shipping. Responsibilities Fast iteration and backlog leadership
Translate the VP’s strategy into a sequenced backlog of problems, user stories, and acceptance criteria that the Engineering team can deliver continuously.
Keep work “thin-sliced” so the team can ship frequently, learn quickly, and reduce risk through iteration.
Maintain a disciplined cadence of backlog refinement, sprint readiness, and scope negotiation to keep delivery predictable without slowing innovation.
Deep user and workflow understanding
Leverage your hands-on DevOps experience and expertise in the real-world workflows of the professionals you’re building for - especially cloud operators and practitioners.
Use firsthand domain knowledge and ongoing customer conversations to identify friction, gaps, and opportunities for differentiation.
Prioritize enhancements that materially improve outcomes: speed, reliability, clarity, safety, governance, cost impact, or operational simplicity.
Customer validation and external communication
Often speak with customers (aiming for 3-5 calls a week) and cross-functional DoiT stakeholders regularly to test ideas, validate assumptions, and pressure-test tradeoffs.
Communicate clearly and confidently: share concepts early, take feedback openly, synthesize input into decisions, and explain “why” in a way that builds trust.
Rely on your hands-on, DevOps experience to go deep with stakeholders (internal/external) into the technical details of the problem, our solution, and the contexts and environments in which both of these exist.
Support beta/design-partner motions where appropriate by shaping hypotheses, success criteria, and rollout plans.
Engineering-embedded technical product ownership
Operate as a core member of the Core Services’ Engineering team - present in daily collaboration, crisp in decision-making, and pragmatic about constraints.
Partner with Engineering leads on sequencing, technical tradeoffs, and delivery planning - ensuring product intent survives implementation realities.
Ensure Core Services are cohesive across UX, APIs, data, and operational behavior - and that it meets a high bar for reliability and customer trust.
Quality, outcomes, and measurement
Define what “success” means for Core Services with clear metrics (adoption, activation, workflow completion, time-to-value, retention, reliability signals, customer-reported impact).
Instrument learning: make sure releases are measurable and that insights reliably flow back into prioritization.
Own release readiness for Core Services: documentation, enablement inputs, and clear communication of what’s new and why it matters.
Safety, governance, and trust by design
Ensure product requirements account for real-world cloud environments: IAM boundaries, auditability, guardrails, and safe defaults.
Partner with security, support, and customer teams to anticipate edge cases and ensure Core Services earns trust over time.

7–10 years of hands-on experience as a Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, SRE, Cloud Engineer, Solutions Architect, or a similar roles working with or building products for public cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, and/or Azure).
A strong product sense for turning messy problems into clear scope and shipped value - without waiting for perfect information.
Systems thinking: Ability to reason about complex distributed systems, architectural tradeoffs, and long-term platform evolution.
Prioritization: Demonstrated ability to balance customer needs, engineering constraints, and platform investments when making prioritization decisions.

As Principal Product Manager, Intelligence Systems, you will serve as the senior product leader for Enterprise AI's intelligence systems portfolio, defining the vision, shaping the roadmap, and driving execution for a workforce of AI agents built on models, workflows, and intelligence services.

Define and communicate the product vision for Enterprise AI's intelligence systems portfolio, including AI/ML models, AI Control Tower, foundation services, evaluation and observability, and value instrumentation.

Build structured Customer Zero feedback loops that turn ServiceNow's own internal AI adoption into credible product learning, not just status reporting.

Manage expectations across senior stakeholders, creating executive-ready roadmap views, decision memos, and value updates.

Notre ambition? Révolutionner le quotidien de nos abonnés, en promouvant une façon plus durable de cuisiner et en leur faisant découvrir de délicieuses recettes, créatives et équilibrées. L’alliance parfaite entre technologie et gastronomie, pour un maximum de gourmandise.
HelloFresh est présent dans plus de 15 pays. La France, un jeune marché lancé en 2019, connaît une ascension fulgurante : nous y sommes déjà leaders depuis 2021. Le moment parfait pour rejoindre notre équipe et avoir un impact fort dans l'une des scales up françaises les plus prometteuses !
Comment rendre tout cela possible ? Grâce à une équipe talentueuse et dynamique, des valeurs fortes de bienveillance et de diversité, et un environnement de travail stimulant.
Si tu souhaites prendre part à cette incroyable aventure humaine, internationale et entrepreneuriale, rejoins-nous !

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un.e Senior Product Manager rockstar dans notre équipe Produit. En tant que Senior Product Manager, tu seras au cœur de la stratégie d’amélioration de notre produit, et de nos nouveaux lancements, et à l’intersection de plusieurs équipes et projets clés pour l’entreprise.
Il ne s’agit pas simplement de gestion de projet, mais d’un poste clé où tu pourras façonner la vision produit physique d'HelloFresh en France.

Mais au-delà de définir la direction, c’est un rôle où il faut faire le lien entre stratégie, données et exécution, en pilotant des initiatives cross-fonctionnelles complexes de la conception jusqu'à l’exécution.

Ce rôle se caractérise par sa diversité : tu pourrais passer une journée à creuser des données de rétention client, la suivante à coordonner le déploiement d'un produit innovant à la croisée entre nos équipes Culinaire, Menu Planning et Ops, et la troisième à présenter une stratégie de monétisation au CEO.
Si tu veux être au cœur des tendances food and impacter la manière dont nos consommateurs voient notre produit chaque semaine, alors ce poste est fait pour toi !

Construire la roadmap stratégique de notre produit, identifier et quantifier les prochains relais de croissance liées à notre offre, sur la base d’analyses sur notre produit physique (données clients, performance produit), et d’une compréhension solide des tendances de marché,
Porter notre stratégie d’innovation produit: offres de recettes tendance et différenciées, nouvelles fonctionnalités, etc. en lien avec les équipes Produit Globales, pour réinventer l’expérience culinaire de nos clients,
Orchestrer de bout en bout des lancements de produits à fort impact, en fédérant les équipes culinaire, menus, produit digital, marketing et production autour d'une vision commune,
Concevoir une offre de monétisation ambitieuse et rentable — recettes premium, épicerie, swap d'ingrédients — pour maximiser la valeur perçue et la performance financière,
Faire évoluer notre produit digital aux côtés des équipes Tech et Produit Globales, en relayant les besoins clients afin de les transformer en fonctionnalités concrètes.

Senior Product Manager (ShelfView)
Scandit ZURICH
Imagine the what. Build the how.
Scandit gives people superpowers. Whether enabling delivery drivers to make quicker deliveries, matching a patient with their medication, or allowing retailers to make store operations more efficient, our technology automates workflows. It provides actionable insights to help businesses in a variety of industries. Join us as we continue to expand, grow, innovate, and help take Scandit to the next level.
Your opportunity
As a Product Manager for ShelfView Capture , you will own the strategy and roadmap for how ShelfView acquires shelf data — a cornerstone of ShelfView's hybrid data capture . You'll work at the intersection of UX, mobile engineering, and computer vision to make capture fast, simple, and reliable, and to ensure the right shelf data is collected at the right quality, coverage, and cost.
ShelfView turns images and video from mobile devices, fixed cameras, and autonomous robots into a digital twin of the store, generating insights that remove tedious tasks for retail workers. Your mission is to make the capture experience best-in-class for accuracy, cost, and speed.

Partner with customers and field teams to understand capture environments and translate needs into requirements.
Build and drive the ShelfView capture roadmap toward high throughput, coverage, and quality at the right cost.
Define and deliver a better capture experience (e.g., improved video capture, AR guidance, faster and more reliable first-time-right capture).
Own how capture work is tasked and scheduled — which stores and aisles are captured, how often, and by whom.
Own store onboarding and modeling — getting stores ready (mapping, planograms, catalogs) and keeping them current as stores change.
Define capture quality, product metrics, and telemetry , and run experiments to inform iterative development.
Work closely with design, mobile engineering, and CV teams to evaluate new technologies that improve capture success
Drive non-mobile, hybrid capture (fixed camera, robot and emerging technologies).
Coordinate feature launches with product marketing and sales operations; act as the capture point of contact on pilots and early customer rollouts.

Degree in Engineering or a related field.
6+ years of product management experience in a "Deep Tech" or mobile SaaS company, or equivalent product leadership experience in a startup.
Experience with mobile apps, AR use-cases, or on-device ML is beneficial.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills to identify user needs; comfortable working hands-on with data/telemetry.
Open-minded, sociable, and driven personality.
Excellent English communication skills, both written and oral.
Eligible to work in Switzerland.
Ability to visit customers in Europe and North America on occasion.
You will either be living within a commutable distance of our Zurich office.

En TCIT valoramos a profesionales que puedan liderar el “puente” entre negocio y tecnología: traducir necesidades, ordenar el trabajo del equipo y sostener el foco en el resultado.
Requisitos y experiencia
Formación proveniente de la UC, UAI y/o UTFSM .
Experiencia en soluciones tecnológicas y productos digitales en el sector financiero.
Dominio de metodologías ágiles para la gestión de productos y la coordinación con equipos.
Habilidades de comunicación para alinear requerimientos con heads de negocio y stakeholders.
Experiencia en empresas de Banca y/o Fintech.
Manejo de Inglés B1-B2
Competencias y habilidades personales
Orientación a resultados y capacidad para priorizar según valor de negocio.
Pensamiento analítico: ordenar información, gestionar dependencias y detectar riesgos.
Alta coordinación y seguimiento: sostener el backlog, la planificación y la entrega incremental.
Comunicación clara y proactiva, adaptando el lenguaje entre negocio y tecnología.
Colaboración: trabajo efectivo con proveedores, equipos de desarrollo y áreas internas.
Si te entusiasma liderar productos digitales con enfoque en calidad y sostenibilidad, y disfrutas trabajar con equipos ágiles en entornos Cloud, este desafío es para ti.
Como IT Product Manager, nuestra misión es asegurar que las soluciones digitales evolucionen de forma ordenada, medible y alineada al negocio. Tu foco será convertir necesidades y oportunidades en un backlog claro y accionable, liderando la planificación y el seguimiento del producto durante todo su ciclo de vida.

Liderar el ciclo de vida de las soluciones digitales: discovery, definición, planificación, entrega y mejora continua.
Transformar iniciativas de negocio en un backlog claro, priorizado y mantenido (con criterios de valor, alcance y dependencias).
Gestionar el presupuesto del producto/solución, coordinando costos, recursos y planificación con las áreas correspondientes.
Coordinar con proveedores, equipos de desarrollo y stakeholders para asegurar ejecución efectiva y alineamiento.
Definir y hacer seguimiento de objetivos del producto, métricas y resultados esperados, para una gestión basada en datos.
Dominar metodologías ágiles (por ejemplo, Scrum/Kanban) y asegurar prácticas saludables de trabajo con los equipos.
Trabajar con tecnologías Cloud en AWS (u otras), comprendiendo el impacto de decisiones de arquitectura en el producto.
Alinear requerimientos con los heads de negocio, asegurando claridad, trazabilidad y acuerdos sobre alcance.
En este rol, buscamos que aportes criterio para equilibrar valor, esfuerzo y riesgo, manteniendo una comunicación fluida entre negocio, tecnología y terceros.
*Contrato directo con el Cliente

The world's leading brands use our award-winning Conversational Cloud platform to connect with millions of consumers. We power nearly a billion conversational interactions every month, providing uniquely rich data analytics and safety tools to unlock the power of conversational AI for better business outcomes. Fast Company named LivePerson the #1 Most Innovative AI Company in the world.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager – Agent Experience to join the LivePerson Product team and lead the strategy and execution for our Agent and Manager Workspace . This is a highly strategic product area responsible for empowering thousands of customer service agents and supervisors with intuitive, intelligent, and secure experiences that enable them to efficiently manage conversations at enterprise scale.
As the Senior Product Manager for Agent Experience , you will define the vision for agent productivity, AI-assisted workflows, and extensible platform capabilities that power modern customer service operations. Working closely with Engineering, Design, AI, Customer Success, and enterprise customers, you will transform complex operational challenges into seamless user experiences that improve agent efficiency, customer satisfaction, and business outcomes.

Product Strategy: Develop and articulate a compelling product vision and strategy for the Agent Experience, ensuring alignment with LivePerson's overall business objectives and AI-first platform strategy.
Feature Prioritization: Define, evaluate, and prioritize features based on customer feedback, market insights, usability research, business objectives, and product analytics, with a focus on agent productivity, workflow optimization, and operational efficiency.
Roadmap Planning: Create and maintain a comprehensive product roadmap covering Agent Workspace, Manager Experience, authentication, secure forms, AI-assisted workflows, and extensibility capabilities.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Engineering, UX Design, AI/ML, Infrastructure, Customer Success, Sales, and Solution Engineering to deliver scalable, secure, and intuitive agent experiences.
Agent Productivity & Experience: Champion user-centered design principles to simplify complex workflows, reduce agent effort, improve task completion, and enable faster, higher-quality customer conversations.
Customer Research: Engage directly with enterprise customers, contact center leaders, agents, and partners to understand operational pain points, validate solutions, and translate insights into product opportunities.
Market Analysis: Continuously monitor industry trends in customer service platforms, contact center technology, AI copilots, workforce productivity, conversational interfaces, and competitive offerings to inform product strategy.
Go-to-Market Strategy: Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to successfully launch new Agent Experience capabilities, drive adoption, and maximize customer value.
Performance Tracking: Define and monitor key product metrics such as agent productivity, workspace adoption, workflow completion rates, customer satisfaction, resolution times, AI feature adoption, and operational efficiency to guide product decisions.
Thought Leadership: Stay current with advancements in AI-assisted customer service, enterprise UX, agent productivity tools, identity and access management, and modern SaaS product design to drive innovation across the Agent Experience.

5+ years of Product Management experience with a proven track record of delivering enterprise SaaS products or platforms.
Experience building products for customer service agents, contact center operations, employee productivity, workflow management, or enterprise applications.
Strong understanding of authentication, security, APIs, enterprise integrations, identity and access management, and cloud-native architectures.
Experience working closely with UX designers to build intuitive, user-centric enterprise experiences.
Proven ability to define product strategy, prioritize initiatives, and execute roadmaps in fast-paced Agile environments.
Strong analytical skills with experience using qualitative and quantitative data to drive product decisions.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
Experience engaging directly with enterprise customers to understand workflows, pain points, and operational challenges.
Passion for AI, customer experience, enterprise productivity, and solving complex business problems through thoughtful product design.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field (MBA preferred).

s.h: Some key info for you about Liberis
s.t:
🌱 We were founded in 2007

💰 We have provided over $3bn of funding to small businesses so far

🚀 We have been named in CNBC & Statista Top 150 UK Fintechs for 2025

🌍 We're a global team, with a dynamic presence in 6 key locations around the world

👩🏾 🤝 👨🏼 We're a vibrant melting pot, celebrating over 27 nationalities in our team

🏢 Our team brings experience from over 740 previous companies, from startups to global giants

🎯 We have just been named as one of FinTech’s Finest 50 by Welcome to the Jungle

💪 We’re proud to be an accredited Real Living Wage employer, ensuring everyone is paid fairly for the great work they do!

Liberis is in the middle of a meaningful shift. We started as a single-product business and are quickly becoming a truly multi-product embedded finance company, with different funding structures, revenue models and customer relationships sitting alongside each other in the same portfolio. That complexity creates real demand for better data, better insight and clearer thinking about how all of it fits together - with this role sitting at the centre of that challange!

As our Senior Data Product Manager, you’ll sit right at the intersection of product, analytics, engineering and senior leadership, helping define the data products that power smarter decisions across Liberis.

You’ll have real ownership over roadmap, prioritisation and ways of working, and your work will directly influence how teams access, understand and use data day to day. This role is a high-impact opportunity for someone who wants to shape how a business uses data at scale!

You’ll be joining a team with a broad remit and a genuine mandate to improve the data experience across the company, so there’s a lot of scope to make the role your own and shape the future of the domain.

You will own the data and insights product for Liberis, building the foundations that let our commercial, credit and operations teams actually understand the business they're running.

That means, thinking carefully about the entities in our data model, how products and customers relate to each other, how those relationships surface in reporting and analysis - and how it eventually all comes out in great dashboards, tools and self-serve capabilities.

This is about shipping products which are genuinely useful, not just technically correct.

Our Engineering Team is going through an AI-first transformation, rethinking how teams are structured and how they ship. Data, insights and analytics are a crucial part of that journey and you will be a key player in leading, innovating and rapidly improving our posture and capabilities at the intersection of data and AI.

If you like solving genuinely hard problems, bringing clarity to complex environments and building products that have visible business impact - this is the role for you!

Your primary job is to help Liberis's commercial decision makers understand the small businesses we serve and how they consider, use and perform across our product range. Doing this well requires a clear conceptual model of the business and a willingness to engage with stakeholders across the business, as well as taste and customer empathy in developing a great insights product including dashboards, insight tools and self-serve capabilities.

You will own the roadmap for our internal data & insight products. Working with stakeholders across commercial, credit, finance and operations, you will define what good looks like and then work with your team to build it. You will run prioritisation, manage the backlog and make decisions about where effort goes.

You will also spend a meaningful amount of time in the detail, reviewing data models and dashboards, asking hard questions about definitions, and making sure what we ship is accurate and trusted.

You will partner closely with the engineering side of your team on how data is modelled and structured in BigQuery and DBT, and with analysts on how it gets presented in Looker. You don't need to write production code, but you need enough technical understanding to be a genuine partner in those conversations. You will also be responsible for continuing to expand our partner-facing reporting, whereby partners gain visibility into their portfolio.

This role requires someone who can think clearly about complex data structures and translate that thinking into products that non-technical people actually find useful. The ideal person has strong conceptual thinking skills, great product instincts and enough technical depth to earn the trust of the engineers and analysts they work with.

· Proven experience in a senior data product or analytics product role in a business with real complexity

· A track record of helping commercial teams make better decisions through better data, not just shipping dashboards

· Strong ability to think about entities, taxonomies and relationships in data

· Hands-on experience with Looker and LookML and familiarity with best practices and scalable approaches to these systems

· Working knowledge of SQL, DBT and BigQuery, enough to engage seriously with how data is modelled and what's feasible, and to express your thinking in code-speak where needed

· Experience working with a multi skilled team of analysts and data engineers

· Clear, confident communication with senior commercial stakeholders

Next steps If this opportunity feels like the right fit for your next career move, we’d love to hear from you!

Even if you don’t meet every requirement, don’t hesitate to apply or reach out to Chess (Internal Recruiter) on

Working together in person helps us move faster, collaborate better, and build a great Liberis culture. Our hybrid working policy requires team members to be in the office at least 3 days a week, but ideally 4 days. At Liberis, we embrace flexibility as a core part of our culture, while also valuing the importance of the time our teams spend together in the office.

Genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel.
Wir suchen keinen klassischen Finance-Experten. Wir suchen jemanden, der komplexe Prozesse versteht, gerne analytisch arbeitet und Spaß daran hat, gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen und Entwicklern intelligente Lösungen zu entwickeln.
Wenn Du Geschäftsprozesse lieber neu denkst als verwaltest und Daten für Dich mehr sind als Tabellen, solltest Du weiterlesen.
Deine Mission
Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Business, Technology und Data.
Gemeinsam mit Finance, Business Intelligence, Engineering und unseren Softwarepartnern entwickelst Du unsere Business-Systeme rund um Payments und Revenue kontinuierlich weiter. Dabei sorgst Du dafür, dass Prozesse einfacher, intelligenter und stärker automatisiert werden und wir jederzeit auf verlässliche Daten und Kennzahlen vertrauen können.
Das erwartet Dich
Prozesse gestalten statt verwalten
Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse, hinterfragst etablierte Abläufe und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen effizientere, skalierbare und automatisierte Lösungen.
Business und Technologie verbinden
Du verstehst fachliche Anforderungen, entwickelst daraus Lösungskonzepte und stimmst deren Umsetzung mit unseren Engineering-Teams und externen Softwarepartnern ab.
Daten intelligent nutzen
Gemeinsam mit unserem BI-Team entwickelst Du KPIs, Reports und Dashboards. Wenn Du Freude daran hast, erstellst Du Analysen auch selbst – beispielsweise mit BigQuery oder Tableau.
Automatisierung vorantreiben
Du identifizierst manuelle Abläufe, entwickelst Automatisierungskonzepte und begleitest deren Umsetzung.
Fraud bekämpfen
Du entwickelst unsere Prozesse zur Fraud Detection & Prevention kontinuierlich weiter und nutzt Datenanalysen, um Risiken frühzeitig zu erkennen.
Business-Plattformen weiterentwickeln
Du arbeitest an Themen wie Payments, Billing, Partnerabrechnung, Revenue Reporting, Datenqualität und Prozessautomatisierung und entwickelst unsere Systemlandschaft kontinuierlich weiter.

gerne komplexe Zusammenhänge verstehst und vereinfachst
technische Lösungen schnell durchdringst und Dich mit Entwicklern auf Augenhöhe austauschen kannst
analytisch denkst und Entscheidungen gerne auf Basis von Daten triffst
Prozesse hinterfragst und Freude daran hast, bessere Lösungen zu entwickeln
strukturiert arbeitest, Verantwortung übernimmst und Themen eigenständig vorantreibst

About Oula
Oula Health is a venture-backed, midwifery-led maternity and GYN care company building the next generation of women's healthcare. We partner exclusively with major health systems — including Mount Sinai, Stamford Health, and Novant Health — to embed our collaborative OB-GYN and midwifery model directly inside their networks. We're a team of ~100 people at Series B stage, with 4 clinics today and three more opening in 2026.

At Oula, our product doesn't sit alongside our EHR — it integrates directly into it. Every product and engineering decision has downstream consequences for how our EHRs are configured, and every EHR configuration decision shapes what's possible on the product side. Someone has to hold both at once.
We're looking for a technically-minded Product Manager to own and evolve our core technology stack — including our EHR, patient portal, and care management platform. This role sits at the intersection of product, operations, and health system integration, serving as the internal and external subject matter expert on our EMR and the primary lead for health system EHR integrations.
You'll manage the day-to-day health of our tech stack, partnering closely with both internal teams and external health system stakeholders to ensure our systems run smoothly and our integrations deliver.

You can sit with a midwife and understand why a clinical template matters, then turn around and write a bug ticket that engineering can actually action, then build the SOP so the next market launch doesn't require you to be in the room. When things are ambiguous (and they often are), you'll lean in rather than wait for clarity.
What You'll Own
EHR Configuration & Clinical Systems
Own day-to-day management of our core tech stack: the EHR, patient portal, and care management platform
Own Athena and Epic configuration end to end: clinical templates, order sets, lab configurations, payer connectivity, and access management for clinical and ops staff
Lead EHR integration efforts as the internal and external subject matter expert — FHIR/HL7 data exchange, health system IT coordination and committed go-live timelines
Own and accelerate Epic integration timelines as we onboard additional health system partners
Maintain configuration integrity as new markets launch and care model workflows evolve
Partner with our IT team on infrastructure; own the clinical systems layer they don't touch
Product Operations & Launch
Own bug intake and prioritization from Market Operations — standardize how Engineering receives, scopes, and resolves issues and communicates status back to the field
Build structured launch toolkits and training materials so clinic teams are prepared for new feature rollouts on day one
Coordinate end-to-end launches across Product, Engineering, and Operations
Identify where AI and automation can reduce manual administrative burden in product operations workflows
Standards & Knowledge Management
Build and maintain the clinical systems SOP library so new market setup is repeatable — documented well enough that a new hire can execute without you in the room
Develop onboarding materials for clinic managers and clinical staff on EHR workflows and tooling
Drive feature parity efforts so patients and clinicians experience a consistent standard of care across markets
Data & Reporting
Build and maintain dashboards tracking feature adoption, issue resolution, and rollout health across clinics
Develop quarterly reporting for Product, leadership, and health system partners on platform performance
Ensure data infrastructure is in place to measure the impact of every feature rollout

3+ years with product operations, technical program management, or PM-adjacent work — ideally at a growth-stage digital health or services company
Strong problem-solving instincts and genuine curiosity — you like figuring out how things work and making them work better
Ease with ambiguity and a bias toward action; this role requires you to create the playbook, not execute someone else's
Demonstrated ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and drive aggressive timelines — ideally with client-facing or health system-facing experience
Ability to speak ‘multiple languages’ – comfort going deep on technical details while communicating clearly to non-technical audiences; you can write a bug ticket, an SOP, and a launch plan that people actually follow; hands-on EHR configuration and integration experience strongly preferred

What Success Looks Like
In your first 90 days, you've audited our current Athena configuration, identified gaps, and have a remediation plan. You understand the bug triage process well enough to have improved it. You've met your counterparts at every health system partner and know what's coming for the next Epic integration.
At six months, new market launches have a repeatable systems and product checklist. Clinic teams know what to expect before a feature goes live. Bug resolution time is measurably faster and the field is no longer sending issues into a black hole.
At one year, the SOP library is comprehensive, clinical systems configuration is stable and documented, and you've successfully navigated at least one new health system EHR environment. The product team has a reliable partner and the ops team isn't dependent on any single person for systems knowledge.

Midjourney is an independent research lab exploring new mediums of thought and expanding the imaginative powers of the human species. We are a small, self-funded team focused on design, human infrastructure, and AI.
Most of the products we build don’t have obvious precedents. We need product managers who can help teams navigate that uncertainty, make decisions, and turn ambitious ideas into products people can actually use.

s.h: We’re looking for a Product Manager to help lead that effort.
s.t:
You’ll work closely with design, engineering, and research throughout the product development process, using tools like Claude Code to prototype concepts. You’ll help teams stay organized, make thoughtful decisions, and move projects from early ideation to launch.
This is a hands-on role. Some days you’ll be writing product specs, running standups, and coordinating launches. Other days you’ll be interviewing users, reviewing prototypes, or digging into product questions that need deeper investigation. If you enjoy bringing structure to creative work and making it easier for great teams to do their best work, you’ll probably enjoy it here.

Own the execution of major product initiatives.
Partner closely with design and engineering from early exploration through launch.
Write product requirements, manage backlogs, and keep projects moving.
Facilitate planning, standups, reviews, and comms between teams.
Help teams make informed decisions through UXR, research, and using Midjourney deeply yourself.
Go deep on important product questions when needed, whether that means conducting user research, designing experiments, or working through a difficult product tradeoff.
Help teams decide what matters most and make smart choices about quality, scope, and speed.
You might be a fit if
You’ve spent the last several years building software people love to use.
You know how to create structure without weighing a team down.
You’re as comfortable writing a product spec as you are talking to users or reviewing a prototype.
You have a point of view, but care more about getting the product right than being right.
Using Claude Code and Cursor are part of your workflow.
You’re excited to build products that don’t come with established playbooks.
Work > ego

Define and execute the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our data platform, enabling scalable, reliable, and AI-ready data infrastructure.

Riot Singapore is seeking talented, passionate Rioters with backgrounds in all areas of game development to build games that make it better to be a player.
That’s where you come in.
Game Product Managers at Riot lead passionate teams to create and evolve products and experiences for our players. We seek to deeply understand our product’s audience and drive strategy to create value for players and for Riot. We help concept, build, and influence projects at all stages of production.
As Principal Game Product Manager, Cosmetics for Teamfight Tactics (TFT) , you will lead the TFT Cosmetics team within the Acquisitions, Expression, and Events (AXE) initiative. You will own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and product outcomes for TFT's cosmetics portfolio, spanning existing offerings, new content types, exclusive content, store features, and long term cosmetics research and development.
This is an individual contributor role in which you will serve as the product lead for a multidisciplinary team in Singapore, setting product direction, defining priorities, and driving product decisions across producers, artists, designers, analysts, researchers, marketing partners, and other specialists.

While you will not have formal people management responsibilities, you will be expected to lead through influence, bringing teams together around a shared strategy and empowering them to deliver exceptional player experiences.
Working closely with TFT leadership and stakeholders in our Los Angeles headquarters, you will balance player insights, creative ambition, and commercial outcomes to shape the future of TFT's cosmetics portfolio. Success in this role means creating cosmetics that resonate with players, building a healthy and innovative portfolio, and establishing a long term strategy that supports TFT's continued growth.

Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for TFT's cosmetics portfolio, driving player engagement and commercial success.
Lead the multidisciplinary cosmetics team by defining product priorities and aligning partners around them.
Collaborate with artists to create content that resonates deeply with players, elevating their creative vision to achieve product goals.
Manage product KPIs, leveraging performance reporting, experimentation, revenue models, and deep dive analysis and research to improve decision making.
Identify product challenges and opportunities, including cosmetics research and development, formulate strategies and plans, and build stakeholder buy in.
Develop decision frameworks, product briefs, and other artefacts that guide downstream decisions and create clarity across teams.
Partner with Production to translate strategy into executable plans, including roadmap sequencing, capacity planning, prioritization, and sustainable live operations.
Navigate the broader TFT and Riot organization to drive cohesive action across Marketing, Regional Publishing, IP and League Creative, Brand Partnerships, and other cross functional partners.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to drive product strategy and product management across the Core Banking domain and to own the most complex, cross-functional core related initiatives. This is a senior individual-contributor role: you set direction, connect product strategy to the platform's technical strategy, and deliver measurable outcomes in partnership with engineering.
You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, sponsoring pre-consensus bets with a written thesis, setting operating rhythms for the Core PM group, and influencing VP/SVP stakeholders through documented trade-offs. You will be an authority on how a core banking system actually works — down to posting logic — and pair that with strong traditional product-management judgment across pricing, risk, product performance, compliance, legal, GTM, and partnerships.

With your PM colleagues, own and drive product strategy and roadmap across multiple Core domains (e.g., deposits, postings/ledger, product factory, transactions) and the end-to-end core product.
The most complex cross-company initiatives — including core conversion enablement and US market-expansion capabilities.
Connecting product strategy to org-level technical strategy; anchoring build vs. buy vs. partner.
Product GTM with measurable outcomes and documented reviews, in partnership with Marketing, Sales, Ops, and client teams.
Operating models and planning frameworks for the Core PM group; standards and playbooks other PMs build on.
Regulatory posture and responsible-AI principles embedded into the Core product.
Product Strategy & Roadmapping
With your PM colleagues define and own multi-domain product strategy and the multi-quarter roadmap for Core Banking.
Translate business, regulatory, and client needs into clear product outcomes; frame problems others haven't yet articulated.
Conduct appropriate research and synthesize findings.
Make informed trade-offs across speed, quality, scalability, and regulatory requirements.
Delivery & Execution
Partner with Engineering Managers on prioritization, sequencing, planning, and dependency management across teams and squads.
Set operating rhythms and planning frameworks; remove cross-team hurdles and drive quality and velocity improvements.
Maintain a coherent, prioritized product direction as priorities shift.
Stakeholder & Client Collaboration
Act as the senior product interface for business, operations, compliance, risk, legal, and technology stakeholders.
Influence VP/SVP decisions through documented prioritization and signed trade-offs (timeline, risk, cost).
Represent the Core product with external banking clients and internal SoFi Bank partners.
Technical & Platform Leadership
Apply posting-logic-level understanding of core banking (accounts, double-entry ledger, postings, interest, product catalog, batch vs. real-time).
Challenge business architectural assumptions at the system and cross-org level; prevent unnecessary complexity and maintenance burden.
Ensure the Core product meets the requirements of US-chartered banking entities.
What you’ll need
Bachelor's degree in computer science or relevant field
Deep, hands-on understanding of the inner workings of a core banking system — ideally at the posting-logic / double-entry ledger level.
A track record of building or product-managing a core banking product itself (a platform/vendor perspective) — as opposed to running core conversion or transformation programs inside a bank.
Strong traditional product-management background across several of: pricing, risk, compliance, product performance, legal, communication, partnering, and go-to-market.
A very good understanding of the US banking market and its regulatory environment.
10+ years of professional experience, with significant time in Product Management for complex, regulated technology platforms.
Demonstrated ability to drive strategy across multiple product areas and lead the most complex cross-functional initiatives with a high degree of autonomy.
Excellent written and verbal communication in English; able to shape company-level product communication and executive-ready written theses.

LatAm core banking exposure and/or Spanish-language proficiency.
Experience with modern, API-first, cloud-native core platforms and microservices architectures.
Familiarity with the competitive landscape (e.g., Thought Machine, 10x, Mambu, Finxact, FIS, Fiserv, Jack Henry, Temenos).
Experience selling or supporting a core platform for external financial-institution clients as well as an in-house bank.

Truecaller's ads business reaches over 400 million users and is one of the largest in-app advertising platforms in its markets.

We are building a modern, server-driven programmatic stack that we own end to end, and this role owns the platform at the heart of it: the intelligence layer that powers demand-supply matching across all our demand channels.

Every ad opportunity flows through this platform, and it decides how that opportunity is valued, priced, auctioned, and allocated to maximize revenue while protecting user experience.
This is a senior, high-ownership role at the center of a multi-year platform build, working closely with engineering, data science, and the supply and demand product teams.

Own the platform strategy and roadmap: the decisioning, auction, and pricing systems that sit between our supply and our demand partners.
Build auction intelligence: bid landscape analysis, pricing and floor strategies, auction design, and demand orchestration that decides which demand sources to invoke for each opportunity.
Drive yield: deliver measurable improvements in eCPM, fill, win rate, and incremental revenue; identify revenue leakage and close it through platform enhancements.
Optimize for scale: drive initiatives around platform performance, reliability, and latency as traffic volumes and demand partners grow.
Shape the long-term architecture: capabilities like traffic shaping, audience-based packaging, and curated marketplaces that turn the platform into a durable competitive advantage.
Run a rigorous operating cadence: define platform KPIs and operational health metrics, design controlled experiments, and iterate based on measured impact.

6+ years in product management, with 3+ years in ad tech, programmatic advertising, or publisher monetization platforms. Hands-on experience driving revenue growth through programmatic is essential.
Programmatic depth: Strong understanding of the ecosystem, including unified auctions, header bidding, open bidding, mediation models, oRTB, and auction dynamics. Working knowledge of platforms such as Google Ad Manager, PubMatic, or ironSource.
Monetization fluency: comfort with the full KPI stack (eCPM, fill rate, match rate, win rate, bid density, viewability, ARPU) and a track record of using it to find and capture yield.
Platform product skills: proven experience building large-scale platform products with engineering-heavy teams, and the ability to translate complex business problems into scalable platform capabilities. Good understanding of distributed systems, APIs, and latency-sensitive architecture.
Data-driven rigor: strong analytical skills, comfort with large datasets, and fluency in experimentation, A/B testing, and controlled rollouts.
Stakeholder influence: ability to align engineering, data science, ad operations, and sales around a common platform strategy using data and business insight.
