Join the team as Twilio’s next Staff, Product Owner, Partner Relationship Management.

This position is needed to build extraordinary tools and solutions for our rapidly growing Global Partnerships team in conjunction with our Go-To-Market (GTM) teams. The Partner Support team is essential for the success and scalability of our partner and indirect sales channels. We are the drivers of the system, process, and data improvements that unlock new possibilities across our Sales, Channel Marketing, and Strategy organizations.
This Product Owner, PRM will work to design, manage, and build scalable solutions, specifically for how we manage, enable, and co-sell with our global partner ecosystem.

This is a great role for an experienced Product Owner who is looking to partner with our global stakeholders, leadership, and builders to execute a roadmap that operationalizes highly-visible channel goals alongside critical Keep the Lights On (KTLO) work.

This includes optimizing our Impartner platform, ensuring seamless integration with Salesforce, and maximizing partner portal engagement.
The ideal candidate enjoys solving complex, high-stakes data and process problems, is naturally curious, and is always looking for ways to standardize and simplify while remaining inclusive of cultural or international differences.

Be the Platform Expert: Act as the primary subject matter expert and trusted advisor for our Impartner PRM platform, defining and getting alignment on partner portal workflows, deal registration policies, and lead distribution procedures.
Bridge Business & Tech: Serve as the strategic liaison between the Partner teams and technical teams, ensuring all business requirements are fully documented, articulate the “what” and “why,” and are clearly understood by platform developers.
Map & Optimize Processes: Analyze and document "as-is" and "to-be" process flows to identify gaps, friction points for partners, and automation opportunities that can be converted into technical requirements.
Maintain Ecosystem Compatibility: Maintain a holistic view of Salesforce and Impartner sync logic, user personas, and data flows to ensure portal configurations do not break upstream or downstream GTM systems.
Collaborate on Architecture: Partner closely with solution architects and development teams to design clean, scalable integrations between Salesforce.com, Impartner, and adjacent marketing automation or ERP technologies.
Drive End-to-End Delivery: Collaborate with end-users, technical squads, and change enablement teams from initial discovery through requirements gathering, build, user acceptance testing (UAT), and deployment.
Own the PRM Roadmap: Maintain a quarterly operational roadmap of enhancements for the partner experience, targeting increased channel efficiency, accurate pipeline reporting, and readiness for scale.
Measure What Matters: Set and track critical metrics for all initiatives. You know that a project doesn't end when a feature drops into production, but rather when partner adoption spikes and measurable operational targets are hit.

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

We are looking for a highly organized Project Owner to own execution quality across one of our D2C subscription products. You will be fully responsible for keeping every workstream moving to standard - setting priorities with stakeholders, translating them into clear technical tasks, driving delivery across product, engineering, design, data, and marketing, and taking direct ownership of projects that have no dedicated owner.
This is a high-accountability role suited for someone who treats "almost done" as not done. We hold a high bar: clear tickets, honest timelines, and work shipped to standard. You will inspect the work, keep the team moving when pace or quality slips, and close gaps yourself when a project falls between roles.

Execution Ownership & Process
Set priorities together with stakeholders and maintain a single, agreed backlog
Own the delivery pipeline end to end, from prioritized backlog to verified release
Define and enforce processes, definitions of done, and quality standards across all workstreams
Drive sprint planning, task tracking, and follow-through so nothing stalls silently
Identify process bottlenecks and fix them with structure, not workarounds
Task Definition & Technical Clarity
Translate product and business priorities into precise, developer-ready technical tasks
Write specs with clear acceptance criteria, edge cases, and measurable outcomes
Partner with engineering to scope, estimate, and sequence work realistically
Use AI tools daily to accelerate spec writing, analysis, and QA - and spread what works across the team
Verify delivered work against spec before it ships — and reject what falls short
Standards & Team Accountability
Hold every contributor to explicit quality and deadline expectations
Push pace and raise the bar when execution drifts, directly and constructively
Run reviews and retros that convert misses into changed processes
Institutionalize best practices so quality does not depend on individual heroics
Cross-functional & Unowned Projects
Take direct ownership of initiatives that lack a dedicated owner and drive them to completion
Coordinate across product, engineering, design, data, and marketing to unblock dependencies
Collaborate with the Managing Director to align execution priorities with business goals
Keep stakeholders informed with concise, honest status reporting

Must-Have Experience
3+ years as a Project Owner, Product Manager, or Delivery/Project Lead on a live software product
Proven track record writing technical tasks and specs that engineers execute without back-and-forth
Experience running agile delivery processes (backlog management, sprints, releases) end to end
Demonstrated ability to build processes, checklists, and quality standards - not just follow them
Experience holding cross-functional contributors accountable for deadlines and quality
Working technical fluency: able to discuss implementation trade-offs with engineers credibly
Advanced, daily use of AI tools (LLMs, agents, AI-assisted workflows) to accelerate specs, analysis, and delivery - with command of standard task-management tooling (Jira, Linear, Notion, or equivalent)
Leadership Attributes
Highly structured operator - you build systems that make quality repeatable
Comfortable giving direct, specific feedback and enforcing standards without drama
Bias to ownership: picks up unclaimed problems instead of waiting for assignment
Detail-obsessed about the work itself - reads the ticket, tests the feature, checks the numbers
Clear, direct communicator who operates effectively in a remote environment
Location
Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

Vorantreiben der technischen Weiterentwicklung des Produktportfolios über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus – von der Konzeption bis zur Produktablösung

Thoughtworks partners with clients to build impactful digital products which deliver extraordinary customer experiences. We do this by integrating design, strategy and technology. As a trusted advisor to our client’s leadership, you will partner with them to understand their context and needs, make recommendations, and provide advice and hands-on expertise on taking new products from concept to market to scale.
Drive the innovation mindset and the overall product development lifecycle, utilising lean and hypothesis driven approaches to identify, conceptualise and pilot new products that deliver undeniable value.
Establish the market & competitive landscape, go to market strategy and business case or economic model for the opportunity with our clients.

Contribute to the growth and scale of our evolving business through taking an active part in recruiting, community building, mentorship and driving continuous improvement in practices and techniques.

10+ years of experience in leading new ideas from concept to launch and scale with expertise in go-to-market strategy and developing new revenue streams.
Experience in commercial and economic modelling, including monetisation strategy.
Experience in bringing an innovation mindset into an organisation at scale and creating sustained innovation investment across strategic horizons.
Depth in conducting research and bringing market trends, customer and competitive insights to facilitate strategic ideation to identify opportunities for strategic growth.
Depth and expertise in developing value proposition, using lean approaches to test viability, feasibility and desirable to achieve problem-solution and product-market fit before scaling.
Demonstrated hypothesis and data driven problem-solving orientation with exceptional ability to create structured quantitative and qualitative analyses.
Operate at company, portfolio and product level — defining and executing a strategy, shaping a vision and translating it into a roadmap with clear business and customer value-based measures of success.
Advise clients on becoming a value-driven, customer-centric product organisation and drive the change by introducing best practices in product management, value delivery and measurement and making innovation mainstream.
Expertise in the end-to-end product development lifecycle, agile and lean software development practices.
Professional Skills
Skilled at operating and building relationships with C-suite executives and confident in driving conversations at the intersection of technology and business.
Strong interpersonal skills — active listening, persuading and empathising with others and excellent written and verbal communication.
Ability to formulate and deliver insights around complex business problems in a thoughtful and persuasive manner.
Strong consulting skills and can operate with ambiguity.
Bias for action, and can break down complex problems into tangible steps.
Enjoy collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and can operate as an advisory but also as a hands on practitioner.
Passionate about creating thought-leadership and representing our brand and value proposition in external events, and by writing articles or white papers.
Other things to know
Learning & Development
There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.

We offer amazing benefits from the day you start including private medical insurance, travel insurance, income protection, critical illness, life assurance, pension scheme, personal development budget, 25 days holiday and a ride2work scheme.

We proudly, passionately and actively strive to make both Thoughtworks and our industry more representative of the communities we serve. We promote diversity in all its forms and reject discrimination and inequality. Our diversity and award winning culture inspires our thought leaders and serves to nurture and develop amazing ideas. We believe this makes us a world leading destination of choice for all technologists.
Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment
At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.
Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.
We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment .

About Numan
Founded in 2018, we’ve already grown to be a 300+ team distributed across the globe, united by a singular mission: empowering people to take control of their health.
Numan is transforming health: we’ve built a cutting-edge platform that integrates diagnostics, medication, supplements, digital programmes, and doctor consultations. Giving people the tools they need to maximise life.
To deliver on our transformative mission, we are guided by our 5 company values:

· Patients first.

· Learn fast.

· Own the quality.

· Succeed together.

· Care deeply.
Backed by top-tier investors, Numan is already having a positive impact on hundreds of thousands of patients here in the UK, and we want you to help us deliver this mission!

This role is about taking our platform to the next level: moving toward sophisticated, predictive, and learning-based decisioning, with a clear path toward becoming a regulated medical device.
This is a senior, high-impact individual contributor (IC) role for someone who combines deep system understanding with clinical product judgement and real experience deploying AI/ML. You are AI-enabled, well-resourced, and measure your success by what you ship and move, rather than the size of your team. You move comfortably between high-level strategy and engineering-grade specifics.

Lead the product direction and roadmap for the decision platform, from long-term strategy down to the detail of how a rule actually works.
Decide which features and capabilities create the most scalable value, balancing near-term execution with strategic bets.
Establish and systematically track the success metrics for the platform.
Set the direction for how the platform uses AI and machine learning, embedding predictive and supervised learning systems into production.
Build self-learning systems so the platform continuously improves on its historical recommendations while keeping safety and explainability central.
Read and reason about system architecture. Act as a credible equal in technical debates with engineers, making sharp trade-offs between speed-to-value and long-term scalability.
Help shape the product side of the platform's regulatory direction, including the decision to build it as Software/AI as a Medical Device (SaMD).
Work fluently with sensitive patient data, partnering with clinical and quality colleagues to ensure safety and patient trust fundamentally shape the roadmap.
Proactively show engineering, clinical, design, and other product teams what the platform makes possible, while staying pragmatic about what they can absorb today.

A proven track record as a Senior or Principal Technical PM on complex platform, infrastructure, or systems products.
Hands-on experience deploying machine learning in production, specifically supervised learning or predictive systems.
Experience deploying or regulating software/AI as a medical device (SaMD), or working within closely comparable regulated frameworks.
Direct experience working with rules engines, knowledge graphs, or AI-driven decisioning systems.
Experience in clinical, healthcare, or adjacent domains handling sensitive, highly detailed user data.
Experience operating as a high-velocity individual contributor who leverages AI tools to cover ground that would traditionally require multiple people.

s.t:
Experience scaling platform products across multiple international regulatory frameworks.
Prior experience working directly as a data scientist or software engineer before transitioning into technical product management.
Experience dealing with complex biological or personalized health data points.

Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.
Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.
Team
The US market is Raisin’s fastest-growing region, where our deposit marketplace connects customers with banks to help both achieve better financial outcomes. As a Product Manager within the US Tribe, you’ll play a key role in scaling our growth engine and enhancing the end-to-end customer experience.
You’ll be part of a cross-functional product team, reporting to the Head of Product, US, and collaborating closely with leaders across Marketing, Customer Experience, Sales, and Customer Service. Partnering with our EU-based engineering team, you’ll drive initiatives that strengthen our product foundations, adopt industry best practices, and deliver a best-in-class B2C experience for US customers.

As a Product Manager in the US B2C Experience team, you’ll combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution to shape the next phase of Raisin’s US growth. While no two days are the same, here’s what you can expect to drive:
Collaborate across disciplines - work closely with Marketing and Customer service (US Based), Design and Engineering to craft seamless, industry-leading experiences.
Deeply understand our customers - continuously uncover insights about user behavior, motivations, and pain points to ensure the team is solving the right problems.
Define and deliver impactful solutions - lead the iterative discovery, definition, and delivery of customer and business-facing initiatives that drive measurable results.
Champion the B2C experience - apply proven frameworks and methodologies to design and optimize customer journeys across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, and retention.
Lead user research and validation - design, run, and synthesize qualitative and quantitative research to inform decisions and validate hypotheses.
Own your product outcomes - be the subject-matter expert for your area, connecting company-level objectives to the metrics and levers your product can influence.
Drive data-informed decisions - foster a culture of analytical rigor by improving data accessibility, establishing clear success metrics, and using insights to prioritize effectively.
Facilitate structured discovery - apply frameworks like Design Thinking, Dual-Track Agile, or Opportunity Solution Trees to rapidly explore, qualify, and align on valuable opportunities.
Shape the product roadmap - define and communicate a clear 12-month vision and strategic path, balancing ambition with pragmatism and alignment across stakeholders.
Align and empower stakeholders - maintain strong communication channels to ensure clarity, trust, and accountability across marketing, customer service, and engineering teams.
Foster high-performing collaboration - inspire engagement, ownership, and quality within your team, ensuring everyone is contributing toward shared goals.
Your Profile
2+ years of Product Management experience

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.
We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.
AI agents are changing how everyone works — not just developers writing code, but entire organizations building, deploying, and operating software. Agents are becoming teammates: they write code, run tests, manage infrastructure, analyze data, and automate workflows across every function.

Docker is building a new platform from scratch to make this real — secure execution environments, agent-to-tool connectivity, governance controls, and the infrastructure that lets agents and humans collaborate safely at enterprise scale.
This is a 0-to-1 role. You will define the product strategy and own the roadmap for a new platform that sits at the intersection of AI, containers, and developer experience. You will work with a small, high-velocity team spanning engineering, design, and go-to-market to figure out what to build, ship it, learn from it, and iterate. The early signal is already in market — Docker Sandboxes is one of the fastest-growing new products in Docker’s history — and the opportunity ahead is much larger.
We are looking for someone who builds, not just plans. You should be comfortable prototyping, getting your hands dirty with early product iterations, and improvising when things don’t go as expected. The right candidate has shipped developer tools or infrastructure products, understands how the agentic AI ecosystem is evolving, and thrives in the ambiguity of building something genuinely new.

Own the product strategy. Define the vision, roadmap, and success metrics for Docker’s AI & Agent Platform. Make hard tradeoff decisions about what to build, what to defer, and what to cut.
Build from zero. This is a new platform. You will define the product from the ground up — writing the first specs, prototyping with engineering, validating with customers, and iterating rapidly based on what you learn.
Drive from conception through delivery. Write requirements, work with engineering to scope and prioritize, ship iteratively, and measure outcomes. You don’t hand off specs and wait — you are in the details.
Define how pieces of the agentic ecosystem fit together. Agents need secure execution, tool connectivity, model access, governance, and observability. You will define how these capabilities compose into a coherent platform — and where Docker’s boundaries are.
Think beyond developers. Agents are becoming essential for everyone who builds, deploys, and operates software. You will ensure the platform serves the full range of people who need agents to succeed — from individual developers to platform teams to enterprise operators.
Define the developer experience. Work with design and engineering to ensure that our AI products are intuitive, powerful, and meet people where they are — whether in the CLI, IDE, or CI pipeline.
Collaborate across Docker. You will work cross-functionally to ensure coherent product experiences and go-to-market alignment.
Influence technical direction. Partner with engineering leadership on architecture decisions. You don’t need to write the code, but you need to understand the technical tradeoffs and have informed opinions about them.
Represent the customer. Engage directly with developers, enterprises, and partners. Bring their voice into every product decision.
Overcome blockers. When something is in the way — a missing integration, an unclear market signal, a technical constraint — you figure out a path forward. You don’t wait for someone else to solve the problem.

Experience . 10+ years of product management experience, with at least 5 years on developer tools, infrastructure, or platform products.
Deep technical fluency. You can read an architecture diagram, understand container and VM runtimes, and have a working knowledge of how AI agents, LLMs, and protocol-level tool connectivity work. You don’t need to be a hypervisor engineer, but you need to hold your own with one.
Proven ability to ship 0-to-1 products. You have taken a product from idea through launch in a fast-moving environment. You know how to operate when there is no playbook.
Builder mentality. You prototype, you sketch architectures, you test early ideas with customers before the spec is done. You are a doer, not just a thinker.
Strong product sense and UX instincts. You care about the developer experience at a deep level — from API design to CLI ergonomics to error messages.
Strategic thinking with execution follow-through. You can set a multi-year vision and also write the spec for what ships next sprint.
Comfort with ambiguity. This space is new and moving fast. You thrive when the answer isn’t obvious and you have to go find it.
Excellent communication. You can write a crisp product brief, present to executives, and debate technical tradeoffs with engineers — all in the same day.
Experience growing and monetizing products at scale. You have been part of taking a product from early adoption to meaningful revenue, and you understand the pricing, packaging, and go-to-market decisions that make that happen.

Experience building products in the containers, cloud-native, or DevOps space
Experience with AI/ML developer tooling or the agentic AI ecosystem
Contributions to open source projects
Experience building and scaling a business from zero to significant ARR
What You’ll Work With
We are building a new platform for agentic development. Docker Sandboxes — isolated execution environments for AI coding agents — is one of the first products in this platform and one of the fastest-growing new products in Docker’s history. But this is just the beginning. The platform will grow to span multiple product areas as we define how agents and people work together at scale.

s.h: The technologies you will work across include
s.t:
Secure, isolated execution environments (microVMs, containers, sandboxing)
Agent-to-tool connectivity and protocol standards (MCP and beyond)
AI model serving and inference infrastructure
Governance, policy enforcement, and audit controls for enterprise AI adoption
Local-to-cloud execution and workload portability
Developer CLIs, SDKs, and platform APIs
Container runtimes, image registries, and build systems

Product Owner – Finance Systems & Projects Sobre a posição
Buscamos um(a) Product Owner para atuar como elo entre as áreas de Finanças e Tecnologia, garantindo a estabilidade, evolução e melhoria contínua dos sistemas financeiros da organização.
Este profissional será responsável por liderar a gestão de demandas, incidentes e melhorias sistêmicas, assegurando rápida resposta às necessidades do negócio, além de atuar na condução de projetos estratégicos de transformação e automação de processos financeiros.
A posição exige forte interação com stakeholders de diversas áreas de finanças, capacidade de priorização em ambientes dinâmicos e habilidade para traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções tecnológicas eficientes.
Principais Responsabilidades Sustentação de Sistemas Financeiros
Atuar como responsável funcional pelos sistemas de finanças, garantindo sua operação contínua e aderência às necessidades do negócio.
Gerenciar e priorizar demandas, incidentes e problemas críticos, assegurando tratamento adequado dentro dos SLAs definidos.
Conduzir análises de causa raiz e coordenar planos de ação para mitigação de recorrências.
Atuar como principal ponto de contato entre as áreas de negócio e as equipes de TI para temas relacionados à sustentação.
Avaliar impactos de mudanças sistêmicas nos processos financeiros e operacionais.
Realizar acompanhamento contínuo da saúde dos sistemas, identificando riscos e oportunidades de melhoria.
Gestão de Relacionamento com o Negócio
Manter relacionamento próximo e constante com as áreas de Finanças.
Conduzir reuniões recorrentes de alinhamento, priorização e acompanhamento das demandas.
Levantar requisitos, mapear processos e traduzir necessidades de negócio para equipes técnicas.
Garantir comunicação clara e permanente entre stakeholders, usuários-chave e times de tecnologia.
Gestão de Projetos
Liderar projetos de evolução sistêmica, automação e transformação digital para as áreas financeiras.
Coordenar atividades desde a definição do escopo até implantação em produção.
Elaborar cronogramas, planos de ação, análise de riscos e acompanhamento de entregas.
Conduzir cerimônias de projeto e reuniões executivas de status.
Apoiar processos de testes, homologação, treinamento e gestão da mudança.
Gestão de Backlog e Priorização
Manter backlog de melhorias e demandas atualizado e priorizado.
Definir critérios de priorização considerando impacto financeiro, riscos regulatórios, experiência do usuário e valor para o negócio.
Trabalhar junto às equipes de desenvolvimento para refinamento de requisitos e acompanhamento das entregas.

Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One +, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.
metrify is Enpal’s smart metering unit and the digital infrastructure for a smart energy ecosystem. With tens of thousands of iMSys units installed and scalable processes, we make energy measurable, controllable, and economically viable—and, together with our partners, we are laying the groundwork for new business models for the energy transition.
We are looking for a Product Manager (f/m/x) to join Metrify Smart Metering team and take end-to-end ownership of the core internal data products such as including our Customer Data Model and our billing & pricing engine.
In this role, you will work closely with Engineering and internal stakeholders (Operations, Finance, Customer Care) to turn complex regulatory, operational, and business requirements into a scalable, reliable data foundation. You will build the internal infrastructure that other teams and products depend on from a unified customer identity model to accurate, auditable billing logic.
If you're excited about building platform products where the users are internal teams and other systems, and where success is measured by data integrity, consistency, and downstream reliability, we'd love to hear from you!

You will own the end-to-end lifecycle of our Customer Data Model, including identity hierarchy design (e.g. customer → order → metering point → measurement), data consistency, and governance across systems.
You will drive the roadmap for our billing and pricing engine, translating regulatory requirements (e.g. MaKo, EDIFACT) and commercial pricing logic into reliable, scalable calculation and invoicing capabilities.
You will translate operational and regulatory requirements into clear PRDs, data models, and actionable user stories for Engineering.
You will collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Finance, Operations, and Customer Care to ensure the data foundation supports accurate billing, reporting, and downstream product use cases.
You will define and track success metrics focused on data quality, billing accuracy, system reliability, and reduction of manual/operational workarounds.
You will continuously gather feedback from internal teams to identify gaps in our data model and pricing logic, and prioritize fixes and enhancements accordingly.

You gained at least 2 years of experience in product management in a B2B, or infrastructure product with focus on internal users.
You are experienced in navigating complex domains involving regulation, systems integration, working directly with internal stakeholders and drive the roadmap. You also have experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, especially Engineering and Growth.
You are familiar with API design, and integrations; experience in energy markets, smart metering, or regulatory processes is a plus.
You communicate clearly in English. Knowledge of German is a plus.
You embody agile values and take ownership of identifying the problem, defining what needs to be built, and shaping the solution as it evolves.

Das erwartet Dich
Bei Caspar Health entwickelst Du die zentrale digitale Arbeitsumgebung für Therapeut*innen und Klinikteams weiter. Dein Auftrag ist klar. Klinische Prozesse sollen einfacher, schneller und sicherer werden, damit Fachkräfte mehr Zeit für die Behandlung ihrer Patient*innen haben.
Unser HCP-Produkt verbindet Patientenbetreuung, Therapieplanung und klinische Abläufe. Es wird bereits von Therapeut*innen und Klinikteams genutzt und soll zu ihrer zentralen Arbeitsumgebung werden. Du identifizierst die größten Engpässe in diesen Abläufen und verbesserst sie so, dass Zeitaufwand sinkt, die Nutzung steigt und die Versorgungsqualität erhalten oder verbessert wird.
Als Senior Product Manager verantwortest Du Produktstrategie, Discovery, Priorisierung und messbare Outcomes für diesen Bereich. Du berichtest direkt an den CPO und führst ein cross-funktionales Squad fachlich durch klare Ziele und Entscheidungen. Wir suchen keinen Backlog-Verwalter oder Ticket-Schubser. Du verantwortest Probleme und Outcomes. Roadmap, Backlog und Delivery sind für Dich Mittel, um messbare Verbesserungen zu erreichen.
Deine Herausforderungen
End-to-End Produktverantwortung: Als Product Manager für das HCP-Produkt entwickelst du Vision, Strategie und Roadmap; Dabei priorisierst du zwischen Kundennutzen, Versorgungsqualität, technischer Machbarkeit und wirtschaftlichem Beitrag und machst Zielkonflikte früh sichtbar
AI-native Produktentwicklung: AI (Skills, Agents) setzt du gezielt dort ein, wo Research, Datenanalyse, Prototyping oder Delivery nachweisbar beschleunigt werden; Entscheidend sind dabei die Qualität der Entscheidungen und die Geschwindigkeit des Lernens – nicht das verwendete Werkzeug
Nutzer- und Domänennähe: Regelmäßig arbeitest du mit Therapeut*innen unserer Caspar Clinic sowie externer Kliniken zusammen; Ein- bis zweimal pro Quartal beobachtest du Abläufe vor Ort und übersetzt diese Erkenntnisse gemeinsam mit Produktdaten in priorisierte Probleme und überprüfbare Hypothesen
Hands-on AI-Prototyping & Codebase: Eigenständig entwickelst du Prototypen, um kritische Annahmen früh zu testen. Technische Konzepte verstehst du sicher, arbeitest mit Entwickler*innen auf Augenhöhe und bringst bei passenden Aufgaben auch selbst Änderungen live
Product Craft & Squad-Führung: Dem Squad gibst du ein klares Problem, ein messbares Ziel und den nötigen Kontext; Schwierige Entscheidungen moderierst du souverän, priorisierst konsequent und sorgst dafür, dass das Team Wirkung statt Output optimiert
Messbarer Impact: Noch vor der Umsetzung definierst du, woran Erfolg erkennbar ist; Dabei misst du unter anderem Zeitaufwand, erfolgreiche Nutzung zentraler Abläufe, Nutzerzufriedenheit und wirtschaftlichen Beitrag – Qualität und Sicherheit der Versorgung bleiben dabei feste Leitplanken
Dein Profil
Produkt-Erfolgsbilanz: Du hast ein komplexes B2B- oder SaaS-Produkt end-to-end verantwortet und kannst deinen Beitrag anhand konkreter Ergebnisse belegen; Neue Produkte oder größere Produktbereiche hast du aufgebaut, weiterentwickelt oder neu ausgerichtet
AI-native Builder-Skills: AI und LLMs nutzt du praktisch für Research, Analyse oder Prototyping und kannst zeigen, wie du damit Lern- oder Delivery-Zyklen verkürzt hast; Mit technischen Entwicklungsabläufen bist du vertraut; Erfahrung mit GitHub und Pull Requests ist von Vorteil
Kommunikations- & Moderationsstärke: Komplexe Sachverhalte vermittelst du Fachpersonal und Tech-Teams klar und adressatengerecht; Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab
Autonomie & High-Performance: Themen treibst du eigenständig voran, triffst Entscheidungen in deinem Verantwortungsbereich und machst Risiken früh sichtbar; Unterstützung holst du dir rechtzeitig, bevor Abhängigkeiten oder ungeklärte Entscheidungen den Fortschritt gefährden
Pragmatische Evidenz- & Datennähe: Qualitative Discovery verbindest du mit Produkt- und Geschäftsdaten; Du formulierst überprüfbare Hypothesen, kennst die Grenzen deiner Evidenz und passt Vorhaben anhand neuer Erkenntnisse an – oder stoppst sie konsequent
Unternehmerisches Mindset: Mit einem ausgeprägten Business Sense verbindest du Nutzerbedürfnisse, technische Machbarkeit und kommerziellen Erfolg zu überzeugenden Produktentscheidungen

We are building the world's decision infrastructure: the strategic twin of every industrial organization for complex combinatorial problems. We unlocked what wasn't possible before: mapping reality with its levers and constraints into a computer, then running n-dimensional optimization on critical value-chain decisions. We help Europe stay strong and the German Mittelstand make good decisions between market shifts, orders, machines and people.
Founded by Dana (CEO) and Erik (CTO) from RWTH research, backed by a €2.8M round led by Vorwerk Ventures, with customers live on our optimization models.
We move fast. We care. No patience for problems left unsolved.

You own the product and the priorities behind it. The hard part of that job here is structural: our go-to-market runs vertically, one use case at a time, while the product has to stay general enough to serve the next customer without being rebuilt.
You sit between Sales and Engineering and translate in both directions. Towards Sales: which use cases we can sell today, which we cannot, and what a demo is allowed to claim. Towards Engineering: which requirement is ready to be built, what it needs to be complete, and what we deliberately leave out.
This is an early-stage role and we expect you to shape it rather than inherit it. We are extending the core of the application right now, which means your first decisions land while the product is still taking form. At the beginning, a meaningful part of your work will be spent on customer projects, close to the people whose decisions we model. That is where you see which patterns are worth turning into product.
We will not sugarcoat it: short deadlines, wild workload, and a go to market with the product and its tech that is a day to day focus and iteration process.
What you'll own
The product roadmap and the reasoning behind it: what we build next, in which order, and what we decline.
The boundary between standard product, configuration, and manual work for one customer.
Requirements that engineering can build from: scope, acceptance criteria, and a clear statement of what is out.
What we can credibly promise a customer, including where the product's limits currently are.
Proofs of Value that you run yourself, and responsibility for individual accounts.
Prototypes you build to test features with customers before we commit engineering time.
How product works here: discovery, prioritisation, and the standards between product and engineering.
Your number: how much of what is project work today is standard product a year from now, and the time from a recognised customer problem to a usable capability.
This role is not for you if your strength is backlog, process and ceremonies, if you need research and design capacity before you can decide, if a complex industrial domain is an obstacle rather than the interesting part, if you don't like data or if you need more than three days before your first customer conversation.

A technical and analytical foundation, engineering, data analytics, data science, operations research, quantitative controlling, or finance with real modelling from a technical degree, technical consulting, or technical product management. You will not write production code, but you need to recognise when a requirement creates technical debt, or is built in a way that cannot be reused at the next customer.
5+ years in product management, or consulting with genuine product proximity. More important than the title: you have owned a product area end to end before, not only a backlog.
Experience deciding under incomplete information, and the ability to explain your trade-offs afterwards: what you chose, why, and what it cost.
You can sit with a plant manager or a controller, understand how they decide today, and leave the room knowing what the product has to do about it.
Good to have, not a cut off: optimization experience, deeper knowledge in manufacturing, supply chain or S&OP, enterprise B2B sales cycles involving operations, IT and controlling, or early-stage startup experience.
German C1 or higher, fluent in English.
NRW-based (Cologne office), optionally Munich, Stuttgart, Berlin area or else willing to work hybrid. Open to find a way if we fit.

Impact. You work with substance and lead what the product becomes.
Ownership. You define how product works here: what we build, what we decline, and where the boundary between product and project sits. No approval loops.
The people next to you. You work directly with the researchers and modellers, have access to tech deliveries and execute and build on eye level with the founders.
Exposure. You present your own roadmap and the reasoning behind it to the board, you sit in the core strategy conversations, and you stand in front of the people whose decisions we model.
Feedback speed. You will know directly what you are up to, we speak out loud, we adjust, we grow. Together.
High stakes. Competitive salary and relevant room in the equity package (VSOP) to match your contribution and your career development.
Process: Intro call with Dana or Erik, second call with one from the team, a 60 to 90-minute live case exercise on a real customer requirement, then team conversations in person. Before you decide, ask us to put you on a call with someone who will tell you the good, the bad and the ugly.
"Hustle the day, analyse at night, reinforce something outstanding." Period.

Build an innovative operating system for the dairy industry from 0 to 1, at the intersection of farmers and dairies. Dairy is Root's home market. Data-Driven Approach: Proficiency in defining and tracking KPIs and metrics to measure AI quality, platform adoption, user satisfaction, automation success, and business impact.

The Problem Worth Solving
Generative AI is a powerful reasoning engine — but it operates blind inside enterprise software. It can't map a million-line multi-technologies codebase, trace cross-technology dependencies, or quantify technical debt. When asked to help modernize a legacy application, it guesses.
The industry's answer has been RAG and vector databases. Useful — but approximate. Semantic similarity is not the same as architectural truth.
CAST 's answer: give AI the exact structural blueprint of the application, derived deterministically from source code analysis across 150+ technologies. Not approximations. Actual call graphs, dependency maps, transaction flows — the ground truth of how software actually works. We call this Software Intelligence. We're now building the bridge that puts it directly in the hands of AI agents.

What You'll Be Building

As Technical Product Manager – AI & Agents, you'll own the product definition and roadmap for integrating CAST 's platforms — CAST Imaging and CAST Highlight — into the agentic AI ecosystem. Concretely:
MCP Server & Agentic integrations. CAST Imaging already exposes its structural insights via an MCP server, making any MCP-aware agent — GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Gemini — structurally aware of the application it's working on. You'll drive what data gets exposed, how agents consume it, and what new capabilities this unlocks for developers, architects, and transformation teams.
Hyperscaler partnerships . You'll manage and grow technical integrations with AWS and Google Cloud. Our published research with Google has already demonstrated that augmenting Gemini with CAST 's structural analysis produces measurably deeper results on enterprise codebases. You'll be the product owner turning that into a repeatable offering.
GSI co-innovation. Tier-1 global system integrators are at the forefront of industrializing AI in the software development lifecycle — at enterprise scale, across industries. You'll work directly with them to understand where AI-driven modernization breaks down in practice, what's missing, and where CAST intelligence fills the gap. They're one of your best proxies for real market needs, and a source of product ideas you won't find in analyst reports.
Next-generation retrieval. Our research team is actively exploring approaches that go beyond standard RAG — combining deterministic structural graphs with semantic retrieval to give agents richer, more grounded context. You'll translate emerging research into product bets, defining what gets productized and when.

Hands-on background in software engineering or architecture. You can read a call graph, understand what a dependency means in practice, and have opinions about technical debt.
Experience with agentic AI, LLM integrations, or developer tooling — building products or shipping integrations.
Ability to work across research, engineering, and commercial teams — and translate between all three.
Fluent English. Our teams and partners are global.

Why This Role The intersection of software intelligence and AI agents is where the next generation of enterprise software transformation will be decided. You'll work with a research team that publishes with Google Cloud, ships MCP integrations used by real enterprise customers, and is actively pushing the frontier on how AI understands software at scale. The scope is real. The partners are serious. The problem is unsolved. Reporting to : Head of R&D Originally posted on Himalayas

Über uns
Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser .
In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement.
Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.
Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.
VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG).
Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:
Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,
~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und
digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.
Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.
Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.
Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.

Reliability. Define what "good" looks like for corridor performance, settlement success, and straight-through processing. Set the targets, own them, move them.

Corridor and market design . Each market has its own mechanics and failure modes. You translate that into requirements: what the corridor supports, how failure is handled, what go-live looks like, so the products built on top can make promises to customers and keep them.

Integration standards. You set the bar for what gets built with correspondent banks, local networks, and processors globally. Corridor success rate and STP rate, moved quarter over quarter.

As the Product Manager, you will: Carry out duties and responsibilities for the acquisition, development, and life cycle management of products for delivery of the NLS braille and talking book programs.

Plan, obtain and manage the full product life cycle (design, development, production, operations, maintenance, disposal and replacement); and coordinate with other NLS divisions, Library of Congress (LoC) program offices and external stakeholders.

Have responsibility for the management of data and processes used in design, production, deployment and support of NLS braille and talking book program delivery products.

Create product development and product deployment project plans and schedules; estimate resource requirements; define milestones and deliverables; monitor project activities; and evaluate project progress. Create plans for the development of products for delivery of the NLS braille and talking book programs.

Establish product development project strategies that integrate the efforts of engineers, business analysts, technical SMEs, contractors, LoC patrons, and other stakeholders from other organizations, agencies, and external contracted facilities into an effective project team.

Coordinate the work efforts of subject matter experts and technical specialists charged with the development of products for delivery of the NLS braille and talking book programs in accordance with established timelines.

Luno has spent over a decade making digital assets safe to own. Since 2013, we've helped millions of people across more than 40 countries buy, store and invest in crypto, working with regulators in every market and holding all customer crypto 1:1. That discipline built the licences, banking relationships, custody and compliance machinery that the next era of this market will run on
The financial system is moving on-chain. Stablecoins are the only digital asset class operating at institutional scale today, and while 98% of supply is dollar-pegged, roughly half of global payment flows are not. That gap is the opportunity, and it is largest in exactly the markets Luno has spent twelve years building in.

You will join the Product Management team building Luno’s institutional business: the activation, digital asset account infrastructure and issuance products that let businesses, institutions and partners operate on Luno’s rails. The portfolio spans Luno Institutional and BlockTower, the group’s stablecoin issuance business. You'll report to the Group Product Manager and work in the BlockTower pod with dedicated engineering and UX partners.

BlockTower is the group’s institutional stablecoin issuance business, starting with ZARU, the South African rand stablecoin.

You'll own the products institutions touch: the self-service issuance platform, where treasury teams mint, redeem, distribute yield and report, and Wallet as a Service, which lets those institutions use and offer stablecoins inside their own products and flows.

Your job is to turn a working product into a repeatable one, and to build the foundation on which future local-currency stablecoins launch in new markets.

The issuance platform: the portal, mint and redeem flows, yield distribution, user and access management, approval workflows, statements and reporting
Wallet as a Service: how institutions embed wallets into their own platforms
The boundary: What the platform needs from the underlying Luno infrastructure, and holding the line on what BlockTower owns itself
Repeatability: the next currency, chain, market or wallet use case should be a configuration exercise, not a new build
Commercial shape: Take institutional customers live and convert every manual step in their journey into a self-service product
Customer-centric: Spend real time with the customers themselves: treasury teams, payment providers, market makers and financial institutions, and let their operating reality shape the roadmap
Build the controls institutions require to trust an issuer: auditability, segregation of duties, and reporting that their own compliance teams will accept

You have 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager, including taking a new product from zero to its first paying customers and then through the stage of making it repeatable
You have built for institutional users: treasury, payments, capital markets or banking
You deeply understand stablecoins and the economics of issuance: reserves, yield, minting and redemption, and you can reason about how a product decision moves each of them
You know your way around on-chain settlement - chains, custody, what moves on-chain versus off, well enough to make clear product trade-offs rather than defer them to engineering
You are comfortable operating a young business inside a larger group: small team, broad remit, decisions made with limited information and a parent company whose infrastructure you depend on
You work confidently in a regulated environment and can collaborate with legal and compliance on the controls a licensed issuer must carry
You are credible in the room with institutional customers, you've been the named person in a treasury team, PSP, market maker or bank calls, and you've turned what those relationships taught you into a roadmap
You use AI as part of how you work -in discovery, analysis, writing and prototyping, and you can show where it's changed your output , not just your tooling
